verdict.rationale: The reflect.app homepage claims notes are stored as local Markdown files, synced through iCloud Drive or Git, in an open-source app (reflect-docs-61, -62, -63). Notes kept that way would be owned and readable without the app, and Markdown/HTML export is also documented (reflect-docs-44). However, the academy docs describe a server-side, end-to-end-encrypted store that the API cannot read (reflect-supp-api-surface-bounds) and server uploads for transcription (reflect-docs-51), so the two sets of first-party docs disagree about the storage model. Missing for 10: any explicit statement that the app works fully offline, docs reconciling local files with the server-side encrypted store, and independent or hands-on confirmation that notes live on disk as plain files.
